Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this game. England and Pakistan, Afghanistan and Bangladesh will be playing their warm-up games in a short while. Also, Zimbabwe vs Ireland, in Group B, will be getting underway soon after the game between West Indies and Scotland in which the former is on the brink of a shocking loss. You can switch tabs to follow all the actions. Cheers!

Rohit Sharma, the Indian skipper, says that they batted well but could have been more clinical towards the end. Adds that they want a set batter to bat through which Suryakumar Yadav did to an extent. Rohit is happy with the overall batting effort of India. Feels that you need to be smart when you plan your batting on such big grounds. Tells that there is definitely room for improvement with the ball and he wants to see more consistency. Mentions that you need to change your tactics here in Australia and they are working on it. Smiles and says that they wanted to challenge Shami by giving the final over and he did brilliantly.

Aaron Finch, the Aussie skipper, says that you need to be clinical at the back of the innings. Feels that they failed to capitalize on the end overs. Praises his bowlers for pulling things back after KL Rahul's quickfire knock. Finch is happy with his batting form and tells that he would have loved to win but cheekily adds that you can't win the World Cup in a practice game. Lauds the bowling effort of Agar and he is looking forward to playing New Zealand.
Stay tuned for the interviews of the two captains...

Positives for Australia - Bowling of Kane Richardson and batting of Aaron Finch. Positives for India apart from an unlikely win - Form of KL Rahul and Suryakumar Yadav, Bhuvneshwar Kumar finding his rhythm and Mohammad Shami looking ready for the challenge.

Australia will be shell-shocked at the moment. This was their game to win but India snatched it right under their nose. Aaron Finch finding some form would have pleased the home team and it's a massive boost to them. That said, he failed to close the game and his departure allowed India to stage a comeback. Not to forget Virat Kohli's brilliant piece of fielding to first run Tim David out and then a one-handed stunner to remove Pat Cummins. Overall, it was a good warm-up game for both teams and to be honest, this result doesn't matter much as only the positives will be counted.

What a win for India! They never looked in the game but it was a special effort from Mohammad Shami in the final over. A big statement is made by the pacer who has been missing in action and there were doubts over his fitness and skills as a T20 bowler. In totality, barring Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Ravichandran Ashwin to an extent, the bowling for India was not up to the mark and this is something they will like to address before the main tournament begins.

OUT! TIMBER! Take a bow, Mohammad Shami! He bowls another perfect yorker, on off, Kane Richardson swings all over it and the ball goes through to rattle the stumps. Incredible stuff from Shami. India win by 6 runs.
Kane Richardson to face the final ball. 7 needed more. Can he hit a biggie?

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! A pinpoint yorker from Mohammad Shami. Josh Inglis moves across the stumps to play his cheeky paddle shot but misses. The ball goes through and demolishes the stumps. Australia have shot themselves on the foot here.
Who's in next? It's Mitchell Starc.

OUT! Agar is run out! Short in length and outside off, Agar swings his bat at it but fails to connect. They attempt to steal a bye but Dinesh Karthik throws it to the bowler who knocks down the stumps with a direct hit at the non-striker's end. Agar is not even in the frame.
Ashton Agar is in next. 7 needed off 3 balls.

OUT! TAKEN! Oh my goodness! What a catch from Kohli!  This is full and on middle, Pat Cummins clears his front leg and lofts it towards the long on fence. It looks like going over but Virat Kohli there times his jump perfectly and takes a one-handed blinder. The Australian dug-out behind him is in disbelief.
Commentary.Howout: c Virat Kohli b Mohammad Shami

Commentary.Commentary: A good yorker, on middle, Pat Cummins digs it out to the vacant mid-wicket region for a a couple of runs.

Good work in the deep! Mohammad Shami tries to go for the yorker but serves a low full toss, on middle, Pat Cummins tucks it wide of deep mid-wicket where the fielder does well to cut it out. Two runs taken.
Mohammad Shami to bowl his first, and final over of the match. 11 needed off 6 balls.

Full toss around middle and leg, drifting down, Cummins tries to flick but misses. He is hit on the pads, they appeal but nothing from the umpire. The ball deflects to covers and they cross for a leg bye.
Very full and on middle, Pat digs it out towards square leg and collects two runs.
Fuller and around leg, Josh Inglis attempts for a reverse-batted shot but miscues it badly. It comes off from the bottom edge and loops towards square leg. They cross.
A low full toss around leg, it's eased behind square leg for a single.
Pat Cummins is the new batter.

OUT! RUN OUT! A great piece of fielding from Kohli and Australia lose two in two balls. This is full and on middle, Josh Inglis tucks it to the right of mid-wicket and sets off for a run, Tim David responds too. However, Virat Kohli is quick to pick up and hits the bull's eye at the batter's end. The replay shows that David is well short of his crease and to be fair to him, he did not even wait for the replays. Could this be the turning point of the game?
Josh Inglis comes in to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! Harshal Patel gets the huge wicket of Finch! He bowls his special delivery, a dipping low full toss, on off, slower too, Aaron Finch looks to work it away but is through his shot way too early and misses. The ball goes through and shatters the stumps. A good knock from the Aussie skipper but is there a twist in the tale?
Harshal Patel is back into the attack to showcase his death-bowling skills.

FOUR! Unlucky for Arshdeep! He bowls another good yorker on off, Tim David tries to squeeze it but it takes the edge and races away to the thrid man fence for a boundary. 16 runs needed in 12 balls now.
Arshdeep Singh bowls a good yorker, outside off, Aaron Finch digs it out towards long off for a run.

SIX! Finch shows how it is done! He clears the fence with ease! Arshdeep Singh misses his length and serves this a bit full and around off, Aaron Finch shuffles across and heaves it over the wide long on fence for a biggie.
On a length and on off, Tim David punches it through point for a single and gets off the mark.
Tim David arrives.

OUT! CAUGHT! A tame dismissal for Stoinis. Short in length, around middle and it gets big on the batter who tries to pull it from the crease. The ball flies off the top part of Stoinis' bat and Virat Kohli takes a simple catch at deep mid-wicket. 28 needed off 16 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Virat Kohli b Arshdeep Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Change of pace, short and outside off, Finch cuts it to deep point for a single.
Arshdeep Singh is back into the attack. 29 needed off 18 balls.
Shorter in length and on leg, Aaron Finch moves back and flicks it towards square leg for one.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Marcus Stoinis works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Floated, full and on off, Marcus Stoinis knocks it towards cover.
FOUR! Good shot! Stoinis with his first boundary. This is tossed up, full and on middle, Marcus Stoinis goes down and sweeps it fine towards the deep square leg fence for four runs.

Good work from the fielder! This is a bit short and on leg, Aaron Finch looks to pull it away but gets an inside edge past the short fine leg fielder where Arshdeep Singh gives chase and just manages to keep it in at the last moment. Three runs taken! Given as leg byes.
Flatter, full and on leg, Marcus Stoinis eases it towards long on for a single.
Ravichandran Ashwin to bowl his last over.

Fractionally short and on off, Finch jumps down the track and forces it to sweeper cover. Axar Patel stops it with his boot in the deep and they get two runs. Superb over, just 4 runs off it along with a wicket.
Sliding down the leg side, Marcus Stoinis gets on his toes and tickles it towards fine leg for a run.
Kumar bowls it short and on off, Stoinis punches from the back foot but finds point.
Marcus Stoinis is in next. 42 needed off 27 balls.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Bhuvneshwar Kumar breaks the partnership and gets his second wicket. He bowls this on a good length and around off, shaping away a wee bit, Glenn Maxwell goes for the cut but gets a thick outside edge behind the stumps where Dinesh Karthik makes no mistake this time. A nice little knock from Maxwell comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Dinesh Karthik b Bhuvneshwar Kumar

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and on off, Aaron Finch cuts it towards deep point for a single.
This is back of a length and outside off, Aaron Finch stays there and throws his bat at it but fails to connect.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar to bowl his third over.
FOUR! Connects and connects well this time. 43 needed off 30 balls. Flighted delivery, around off and fuller in length, Glenn Maxwell reverse-hits it strongly over covers and finds the fence.
Aerial but safe! Maxwell mistimes his reverse-batted shot but the ball loops behind Ashwin at covers. They get two runs.

DROPPED! Chahal puts down a return catch. Flighted delivery, very slow through the air. It lands on middle and turns away, Maxwell steps back to cut but it takes the bottom edge and flies towards the bowler. Chahal is late to pick it up and drops it to his left.
Leans forward and works a full ball to square leg for another single.
Floated one, full and around leg, Maxwell tries to play the paddle sweep but it takes the bottom part and goes to deep square leg. They cross.
Slower through the air, on middle, Finch gets back and nudges it towards square leg for one.
Wide! Fuller one, down the leg side, Finch tries to sweep but misses.
Play and a miss! Arshdeep delivers it on a length and outside off, angling away, Maxwell stays leg-side and tries to cut but misses. 17 from the over, 53 needed off 36 balls.

Sublime! A length ball outside off, Finch keeps his weight on the back foot and crunches it through extra cover. Chahal rushes across to his left from long off and dives to stop the ball. The batters get three runs.
Wide! Quite wide outside off, fuller in length, Finch allows it through to the keeper.
Slower one, on a length and outside off, Aaron stays back and hits it through point for a couple.
FOUR! Finch is turning it on now. Fuller in length and on middle, Finch whips it across the line and finds the gap at wide long on for a boundary.
FOUR! Plays late and finds the gap! Back of a length, around off and angling away, Finch camps back and steers it wide of backward point for a boundary. A crucial FIFTY FOR FINCH!
Short again from Singh, outside off, Finch cuts it from the back foot and sends it to deep point for two runs.
Wide! Slower one, short and way wide outside off, Finch leaves.
Arshdeep Singh comes back into the attack now. He conceded four runs in his first over.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries to end the over. Quicker through the air, around off, Maxwell drills it through extra cover for a boundary. 15 from the over, 70 needed off 42 balls.
FOUR! Fine shot! Flighted and on off, Glenn Maxwell, wearing a helmet now, gives himself room and smashes it over extra cover for a boundary.
Quicker one on middle, knocked down to long on for a run.
Halt! Glenn Maxwell has been hit near the left eye as he was not wearing a helmet. The physios are in to check on him. He looks good to go now and is wearing a helmet.

Mishit! Maxwell tries to be innovative with his reverse-batted shot but edges it down to fine leg. They cross. It seems that Maxwell has hurt himself in the process. The replays show that the ball took the top edge, and brushed Maxwell on the face who is not wearing a helmet. The Indian players have surrounded Maxwell. He is looking fine but that's too dangerous to play that shot without the protective gear.
FOUR! Superb shot! Too full in length from Chahal, around off, Maxwell uses the depth of his crease and rockets it over extra cover for a boundary.
Flatter and shorter on off, Finch punches it past extra cover for a single.
Bouncer around off, catching Maxwell by surprise. He tries to duck initially but then hooks it at the last moment. It drops towards square leg and they rush back for the second run.
Short delivery, on off, Finch pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 100 comes up for Australia.
On a good length, around middle and leg, Glenn steps back and guides it down to third man for a single.
Angling in from a length around off, Maxwell tries to work it on the leg side but ends up pushing it back to the bowler.
Shortish and on off, Maxwell plays a mistimed shot from the back foot. It rolls to mid on.
Back of a length, around leg, Finch glances it down to long leg for a single.
Hardik Pandya (2-0-24-0) is back on.
Put down? Quicker through the air, short and on off, Maxwell gets back to cut but seems to have got an outside edge. Dinesh Karthik fails to catch it though.
Flatter and on middle, punched back to the bowler.
Glenn Maxwell is the new batter in for Australia.

OUT! BOWLED! Lovely bowling from Chahal! Serves it slower through the air, around off, Smith tries to play a lofted shot over extra cover but loses his posture completely. Fails to make any contact and the stumps are disturbed. A wicket after the break for India and they would like to capitalize from hereon. 90 needed off 56 balls.
Switch Hit! Tossed up, around off, Finch brings out the innovation but drags it off the inner edge to deep cover. A single for all that effort.
Short again, around off, Smith goes back and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
The leggie begins with a short delivery outside off, Finch cuts it through point for a single.

Drinks break. It has been good going for Australia in this chase. They have lost one wicket but are scoring at a decent rate. Aaron Finch has found some much-needed rhythm with the bat and Steven Smith would also like to stake his claim in the starting XI with an impactful knock. Another 93 runs to get in 60 balls and this game is nicely poised. Also, Yuzvendra Chahal to bowl after the break.
Fuller one and on middle, Aaron Finch chips it towards long on for another run. 15 runs from the over! Australia are on 94 for one at the halfway mark.
This is on a good length and on the pads, Steven Smith helps it towards square leg for one.
SIX! Smith gets into the act now! Patel bowls another full delivery, on leg, Steven Smith stays there and clips this one away over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Length again and on off, Steven Smith plays it straight to point.
On a length and on off, Aaron Finch pushes it towards deep point for a single.
SIX! What a shot! Harshal Patel bowls this full and on leg, Aaron Finch uses the angle and targets the shorter side to flick it over the deep square leg fence for a maximum.
Fullish and on off, it's swept through square leg for a single.
Loopy and full around off, Smith swipes it to deep square leg for a run.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to deep cover for one.
Flatter around middle, Finch steps back and pushes it towards the bowler.
On middle, defended to mid-wicket.
Flatter and around middle, Aaron Finch blocks it out.
Ravichandran Ashwin to continue...
On a length and on middle, Aaron Finch tucks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Fabulous shot! Hardik Pandya serves this a bit fuller, on leg, Aaron Finch uses his wrists to flick it nicely past the deep square leg fielder for a boundary.
BEATEN! This is on a good length and on the fifth stump line, shaping away, Aaron Finch looks to push it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Another hard-length delivery, on middle, Steven Smith gets hurried this time and it hits him high on the thigh pad as the ball rolls towards square leg. A leg bye is taken.
Pandya bowls this on a hard length and on middle, Aaron Finch gets hurried and miscues his pull to the leg side for a single.
This is a touch fuller and on middle, Aaron Finch knocks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Change in bowling. Hardik Pandya returns for his second over. He went for 18 runs in his first.
Floated, full and on off, Steven Smith blocks it out.
Ravichandran Ashwin continues bowling short here, on middle, Aaron Finch moves back and works it towards deep mid-wicket for one more.
Shorter in length and outside off, Steven Smith makes room and cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Short again and on leg, Aaron Finch tucks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
A bit short and on middle, Steven Smith flicks it off the back foot towards square leg for a single.

Slower through the air, on off, Aaron Finch strides forward to play at it but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but turned down. A leg bye is taken as the ball rolls towards short third man. There is no DRS for the warm-up games.
Three dots to end the Powerplay, Australia are 64 for 1. Fuller and on off, Smith helps it to mid-wicket.
Lands it on a length around off, Smith punches it towards cover-point.
Steven Smith is in next at number 3. He also has a point to prove in this format. 123 runs needed in 86 balls.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Bhuvneshwar Kumar gets the last laugh and provides India with the much-needed breakthrough. He bowls this short of a length and just around off, slightly slower too. Mitchell Marsh goes for the cut again but tries to hit it hard and only manages to get an inside edge back onto the stumps. Australia lose their first wicket.
Short of a length again and outside off, Mitchell Marsh cuts it towards deep point for a brace.

SIX! This one has gone a long, long way! Bhuvneshwar Kumar bowls this short of a length and on middle, Mitchell Marsh picks up the length early and pulls it hard over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Marsh taking advantage of the field restrictions here! This is on a good length and on middle, Mitchell Marsh stays there and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar to bowl the last over of Powerplay.
Loopy and on middle, Finch tries to flick but misses and is hit high on the pads. 14 from Ashwin's first.
Short and outside off, Finch cuts but finds the point fielder.
FOUR! This outing will hand some much-needed confidence to Aaron Finch. Fuller and around off, the Aussie skipper drills his drive through the gap between mid off and extra cover. 50 up!
FOUR! Punished! Short in length and around off, Finch camps back and hammers it over extra cover for a boundary.
Flighted around middle and leg, Finch tries to turn it on the leg side but misses.
FIVE WIDES! Ashwin fires one down the leg side, Finch fails to get any bat behind it and Karthik also has no chance of collecting it. It's a boundary at fine leg.
Quicker one, around off and a bit on the shorter side, Marsh gets back and wrists it through mid-wicket for a single.
We will see some spin now as Ravichandran Ashwin is ready to bowl his first over.
Beaten again. Full and outside off, Finch pushes inside the line but it moves away to beat the outside edge. 11 from the over!
Short in length and outside off, Finch flashes his bat at it and misses.
SIX! High and handsome! Patel lands it on a length around off, shaping in, Finch heaves it across the line and sends it many a mile over square leg for a biggie.
Shout for an lbw, not given. A good yorker from Patel, around leg and it's speared in. Finch fails to keep it out and it goes off his right heel to short fine leg. Missing leg.
FOUR! Second boundary for Finch. Short in length and outside off, Finch stands tall and punches it past the diving cover fielder for a boundary.
Harshal starts with a full ball around leg, Marsh clips it past mid-wicket for a single.
We saw this with Australia and India are also going with the same plan of using different bowlers in the Powerplay. Harshal Patel has been introduced into the attack now.
A length ball on middle, Marsh works it in front of square on the leg side for three runs as Ravichandran Ashwin cuts it off in the deep.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it back to the bowler.
SIX! Marsh was in no control of his shot. Hardik Pandya digs it in short, Mitchell Marsh attempts to pull but it flies off the top edge and clears fine leg.

FOUR! Streaky from Marsh! Pandya lands it on a fuller length around off, nipping away, Mitchell Marsh is squared in defense and edges it wide of backward point. The third man fielder is very square and it's a boundary.
Edgy! Fuller in length, angling in around off, Finch slices his attempted drive to deep backward point for a run.
FOUR! Up and over the infield! Finch is off the mark. A length ball around off, shaping away, Aaron leans into the shot and lofts it over cover-point for a boundary.
Hardik Pandya comes into the attack now.
FOUR! Fabulous shot! Too full this time, around middle, Marsh brings down a straight bat and drives it down the ground, past mid off, for a boundary.
A length delivery outside off, angling away, Marsh has a blind swing at it and misses.
Inswinger this time, Arshdeep Singh is showing his arsenal here. Around middle and leg, Finch fails to flick and it goes off his pads to backward square leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Beauty to beat the bat! Singh serves it full and close to off, nipping away, Aaron Finch is half-forward tentatively, trying to defend, but it beats the outside edge by a whisker.
This one goes the other way! Arshdeep bowls it on a good length outside off, angling across the Aussie skipper, Finch allows it through.
Starts with a full ball, around leg and shaping in, Finch tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to square leg.
Arshdeep Singh to bowl from the other end.
Hurls a length delivery in the zone outside off, Marsh has nothing to do with it. A good start from Kumar.
Inswinger this time, around off and on a length, Marsh is on the back foot as he blocks it to the cover region.
FOUR! Crunched! Back of a length, around off, Marsh stays on the back foot and strokes it through the gap at point for a boundary. Australia are away!
Kumar keeps it around off, on a length, Marsh defends it to the off side.
Another delivery in the channel outside off, moving away a bit, Marsh shoulders arms.
A little bit of swing straight away! Bhuvneshwar Kumar serves it on a good length outside off, shaping away a shade, Mitchell Marsh watches the line and lets it be.
